$comment: Frozen contract for the visualization tool. Browser reads these JSON files only — never parquet.

MatchIndex.date: YYYY-MM-DD from Unix t0 (UTC), not the folder name

Match.events: Event[]  — story beats only, no Position/BotPosition

Actor.path: { t, x, z, px, py }[]  downsampled positions, t is seconds from t0

Event.type: Kill | Killed | BotKill | BotKilled | Loot | KilledByStorm

Heatmaps.cells: { ix, iy, n }[]  sparse bins, ix/iy in 0..63

assumptions: Parquet ts is timestamp[ms] but raw int64 values are Unix seconds. Duration = delta of raw ints, not pandas datetime.
Dedupe actors by (user_id, match_id); the same file can appear in two day folders.
Calendar date comes from Unix t0 UTC, not the February_* folder (matches can straddle folders).
y is elevation and is dropped for 2D. Pixel mapping uses README UV + Y flip.
Bot files can contain BotKill/BotKilled, not only BotPosition.
